purpose: Per-genome annotations for ALL25officialECOR and52officialBASEL references, including excluded/pendinggroup cases; no model/training admission.
parser: Biopython1.86 official records; exact hash-pinned prior DNA/protein parsers and ECOR/BASEL record checks.

execution.failure_rule: Any input-preparation failure stops all calls, preserving all77statusrows; either technicalcontrol mismatch/failure stops all77panelcalls. Once admitted to annotation only, per-genome caller/output errors retained and remaining independent genomes still attempted, without retry/flag substitution.
execution.source_preservation: Verify source hashes before/aftereachcall and globallybefore/afterexecution; inputFASTA hashes before/aftercaller.

normalization.contigs: Keep exact original source order, boundaries, uppercased DNA and repeated sequences; never concatenate/trim/rotate/reverse-complement.
normalization.neutral_ids: hNNNcMMMMMM or pNNNcMMMMMM; technicalcontrols ch000/cp000 in separate namespaces; source names/roles not used as features.
normalization.proteins: Preserve raw caller FAA; existing strict parser accepts one terminalstop for multiset hashing only and rejects internal/double stops/invalidAA.
normalization.validation: Nonempty FAA and every protein matched1:1 by callerID to bounded GFF CDS with matching contig/coordinates/strand/partial flags; phase0/1/2. Contigs withoutCDS retained with zero count.
normalization.genetic_code: Host fixed11 as priorcaller; phage metagenomic code selection left exactly as priorGV defaults/flags, reported in raw output; no forcedcode basedonresults.

controls_interpretation: Exact proteome-multiset replay after neutralheader changes is caller/representation compatibility, not biological performance or specificity validation.
